title: Enemy AI Behaviours: Ground (robots/raiders/brutes), Aerial (drones), Turrets
description:
Purpose: Provide modular IBehaviour trees for enemy factions with cover, flank, suppress, aerial strafe, turret lane control, and fear-tainted brute rush with suppression auras. React to constructs (barriers, cages, tethers). Difficulty scales by mission tier.

Behaviour sets:
- Robot Grunt / Alien Raider: Navmesh-driven cover seeking, burst fire, flanking when barrier detected; respect player constructs (avoid lanes blocked by barrier walls, attempt to flank barriers). If caged, switch to break_attempt state.
- Aerial Drone: Maintain distance bands, strafe with jukes, prefer altitude differentials relative to player; avoid dome shield interiors.
- Sniper Turret: Establish a firing lane; advertises a laser; if barrier blocks, reacquire lane or switch to burst mode if flanked.
- Fear-Corrupted Brute: Rush behaviour with area suppression aura (yellow zone) that increases player sustained drain; heavy melee swings with telegraphs; resists tethers more.

Inputs/Outputs:
- Reads: player transform/velocity, construct tags and volumes (barrier, dome), yellow energy zone volumes, mission tier.
- Writes: enemy movement targets, fire control (rate, bursts), state flags, aura volumes for suppression.

Controls mapping: N/A (AI-driven), but integrates with projectile emitters and melee hitboxes.

Comfort/safety: Ensure telegraphing via VFX/animation triggers; no forced camera effects.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_enemy_ai_cover_flank: robots take cover and flank; barriers force reposition.
- test_turret_counterplay: turrets establish lanes; barrier blocks; melee disable when flanked.

Integration:
- Hook via builtin.enemy_ai_hook with params.behaviour_id = "enemy_ai_combat_pack" on the following assets/entities: robot_grunt_enemy, alien_raider_enemy, aerial_drone_enemy, sniper_turret_enemy, fear_corrupted_brute_enemy.
- Uses enemy_projectile_vfx_pack for fire VFX. Consumes promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge API to apply suppression drain multipliers in yellow zones to the player.

Assets/scenes:
- alien_city_attack, open_orbital_battlefield, fear_corrupted_ruins.

Suggested file split: enemy_ai_register.cpp, ai_ground_cover_flank.cpp, ai_drone_strafe.cpp, ai_turret_lane.cpp, ai_brute_suppress.cpp.
